name: – After § 2 – Am 9/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text: 2a. Deeply regrets the deaths of Guardia Civil officers David Pérez Carracedo and Miguel Ángel González Gómez, who were killed in the line of duty in Barbate, Cádiz, on 9 February 2024 when their patrol vessel was deliberately rammed by drug traffickers using a high-powered vessel; pays tribute to their courage, dedication and ultimate sacrifice in the service of Spain and the protection of its citizens; regrets that law enforcement officers are forced to confront organised criminal groups while lacking the means, resources and legal protection necessary to defend their own lives and those of others;
